deployments_detail.use: Deep-learning content-tagging system that automatically identifies characters, scenes and objects in Disney's animated film/TV archive to generate standardized metadata (built on AWS EC2 + PyTorch), later extended to ESPN sports content recommendations [AWS (EC2, PyTorch)]
Disney+ personalization and recommendation engine using ML plus NLP over closed-caption files to reorder content rows, drive Post Play autoplay and tailor recommendations by subscriber segment
ESPN generative-AI game recaps producing text recap stories for underserved sports (NWSL, Premier Lacrosse League), human-edited and bylined 'ESPN Generative AI Services' [Microsoft AI, Accenture]

BDX autonomous free-roaming character robots (droids) trained with reinforcement learning in simulation; deployed as roaming characters at Disneyland Resort and on the Disney Wish cruise ship; built with the open-source Newton physics engine [NVIDIA, Google DeepMind, Disney Research (Newton engine)]

Licensing deal bringing 200+ Disney, Marvel, Pixar and Star Wars characters to OpenAI's Sora video generator, plus surfacing user-prompted AI-generated content inside Disney+; backed by a $1B Disney equity investment in OpenAI [OpenAI (Sora)]

Internal enterprise generative-AI tooling: ChatGPT and Microsoft Copilot rolled out to employees for productivity tasks such as IT requests, internal data lookups and knowledge work; custom internal tools built on OpenAI APIs [OpenAI (ChatGPT), Microsoft Copilot]
AI across content/production, guest experiences (parks personalization/crowd mgmt), enterprise ops (own AI topic brief)

Disney Ad Creative Studio: AI tool inside Disney Campaign Manager that transforms advertiser brand materials into connected-TV video ads, generating multiple creative variations by audience/geography/goal (closed beta)
Disney Ads Agent: agentic AI chatbot for advertisers that automates media-planning prep work including inventory search, audience identification and campaign success tracking (announced at CES 2026)

Disney Advertising AI-powered internal planning tool that captures campaign objectives, audience intent, timing and constraints to accelerate the media-planning process (unveiled at Disney's Tech & Data Showcase)
Generate short user-prompted social videos featuring Disney characters using Sora [OpenAI Sora]
AI-driven ad planning and creative tools enabling advertisers to create TV ads using generative AI
